## R Markdown

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(
  RSQLite::SQLite(),
  "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db"
)

listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

reviews = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

## Task 1
```{r}
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings")

listings_with_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

A1 = host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(host_listings >= 10) |>
  dplyr::summarize(hosts_10_plus = dplyr::n())
A1
A2 = listings_with_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    percent_10_plus = round(
      100 * mean(host_listings >= 10),
      1))
A2
```
# Task 2
```{r}
task2 = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n()
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(n >= 20, city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_price)

task2
```

# Task 3 
```{r}
task3 = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))
task3
task3 |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(estimated_revenue_l365d)
```
#Task 4
```{r}
task4 = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    top_10_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10], na.rm = TRUE),
    total_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent = 100 * top_10_revenue / total_revenue
  )

task4 |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::mutate(percent = round(percent, 1)) |>
  dplyr::select(percent)
```
# Task 5
```{r}
task5 = availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |>
      dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
      dplyr::select(id, city),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    percent_mostly_taken = 100 * mean(mostly_taken, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(percent_mostly_taken)

task5 |>
  dplyr::slice(1) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    percent_mostly_taken = round(percent_mostly_taken, 1))
```
# Task 6
```{r}
task6 = reviews |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |>
      dplyr::select(id, city),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    month >= "2025-07",
    month <= "2026-06"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

twin_cities = task6 |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities")

twin_cities |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    busiest_month = month[which.max(total_reviews)],
    ratio = round(max(total_reviews) / min(total_reviews), 2))
```
# Task 8
```{r}
task8 = listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id")

task8 |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    listings_without_availability = dplyr::n())
```
# Task 7
```{r}
task7 = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),.groups = "drop")
premiums = task7 |>
  dplyr::select(city, host_is_superhost, median_price) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = host_is_superhost,
    values_from = median_price) |>
  dplyr::mutate(premium = t - f) |>
  dplyr::select(city, premium)

premiums
```
